title: Grateful Dead Live at Civic Arena on 1973-09-24

ai_review.summary: A tight 1973 performance with stellar horn work and a standout “Nobody’s Fault > Eyes > Let It Grow” finale, recorded on a mixed‑quality matrix source.
ai_review.review: Fans rave about the show’s high energy, tight playing, and the late‑'73 horn section that shines on the second‑set climax. The recording is a matrix (soundboard + audience) that many find muddy or even awful in parts, though some listeners consider it good enough to enjoy the music.

ai_rating.rationale: Show is praised as one of the best of ’73 (high show rating), but recording quality receives mixed to poor feedback, pulling the overall weighted score down.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Reviews mention a muddy, awful‑sounding first few songs and overall low fidelity; some find it acceptable after the intro, but many label it poor or bad.

standout_songs: Nobody's Fault (In My Own Two Hands) > Eyes of the World > Let It Grow
show_quality.setlist_flow: Strong second‑set climax with horns, regarded as a platform of greatness; overall tight and energetic performance.
